data.text: Luke, I appreciate you offering to sit out, but we don’t need to reduce the stock to benefit from that. If the four of us take 12.5 tons each, we earn $12,500 apiece and leave 50 tons to replenish the lake fully. I’d choose 12.5 if John, Kate, and Jack agree to that limit. From next month, I suggest 10 tons each so everyone earns steadily—including you. My family taught me to leave enough fish for the village’s future. John, would you support that plan?
